summary: Iter 23 — backend + frontend sweep for Jobs feature, Resend OTP integration, and user_kind toggle. Authored /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_jobs_resend.py (18 cases, all PASS in 18s). Frontend: footer Careers modal flow PASS, /jobs list PASS, JobDetail renders fully via direct URL PASS, but two real frontend bugs found — (1) clicking a JobRow on /jobs does NOT navigate to /jobs/:jobId (URL stays unchanged) and (2) ProfilePage has no user_kind toggle widget (only displays current value as a badge). Resend OTP fallback path verified end-to-end: /auth/send-otp returns delivered=False with _mock_code (never 500s) and verify-otp accepts the fallback code. Backend logs confirm [OTP-FALLBACK] lines for non-account-owner emails (Resend test domain restriction).

minor.issue: Duplicate application returns 400 (review_request expected 409). Error message: 'You’ve already applied to this job.' Functionally correct but spec says 409. Either align code to 409 or update spec.
Endpoint is /jobs/checkout (no /session suffix). Review_request mentioned /api/jobs/checkout/session — actual path is /api/jobs/checkout. Works correctly, just naming mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a JobRow card on /jobs does NOT navigate to /jobs/:jobId. URL stays at /jobs after click on [data-testid='job-row-<id>']. Direct navigation to /jobs/<id> renders JobDetailPage correctly, so the route works — the onClick handler on motion.div is the broken piece. Likely framer-motion onClick bubbling or a stopPropagation upstream.

Missing user_kind toggle widget. ProfilePage displays 'PROFESSIONAL' (or 'SOCIAL') as a static badge but provides NO control for the user to switch between Social and Professional. Review_request explicitly required this toggle to persist on refresh.

Professional user without job_post_unlocked sees only the static text 'You need to unlock job posting first ($50 once-off). Back to Jobs' — there is NO inline Stripe checkout CTA on /jobs/new itself; user must navigate back to /jobs and tap 'Unlock $50' header button. Review_request expected the unlock CTA on /jobs/new directly.

issues: When a user is authenticated, '/' renders FeedPage (no Footer component), so the auth-user → /jobs flow via the Careers footer link is unreachable. Flagged in review_request as a known limitation — included here for completeness.

action_items: FIX FE: JobRow onClick → navigate to /jobs/:jobId. Inspect motion.div from framer-motion (may need wrapping div with onClick or using <Link>/<button> instead). Add a Playwright regression once fixed.

FIX FE: Add a user_kind toggle to ProfilePage that calls PUT /users/me { user_kind: 'social'|'professional' } and reflects the change after refresh. Backend already supports it (PUT /users/me validated in tests).
FIX FE: Surface the Stripe $50 unlock CTA inline on /jobs/new for Professional users without job_post_unlocked (instead of only showing the bounce-back message).
OPTIONAL BE: Change duplicate-apply response from 400 → 409 to match review_request and standard REST semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5923 lines (was 5306 in iter22) and continuing to grow. Jobs routes, Resend integration, and seed-job all live in this monolith. Splitting is overdue — every iter adds ~600 lines.
Three @app.on_event('startup') handlers now exist (purge_overdue_deletions, backfill_share_codes, seed_network_capital_job). FastAPI has deprecated on_event; consolidate into a lifespan handler.

_send_otp_email is correctly wrapped in try/except so the endpoint never 500s on Resend errors (verified). Good defensive design — logs both [OTP-RESEND] success and [OTP-FALLBACK] failure with the code.

min_network_score=2000 on the seeded BD Agent job means no fresh signup user can apply via the UI happy-path. Good for production realism, but consider seeding a second open-to-all job for first-run user demos.

JobsPage uses motion.div for the row; the onClick is dropped (frontend bug). Replacing motion.div with a regular div (or wrapping with React Router <Link>) would fix and avoid the framer-motion gotcha.
JobDetailPage has no data-testid='job-apply-button' on the apply CTA — makes Playwright targeting harder. Add testid attributes for apply/close/edit actions.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 18/18 iter23 backend tests PASS (Resend OTP fallback, user_kind PUT, jobs CRUD, jobs checkout, apply gate, regression on /score/summary + posts CRUD + account deactivate/reactivate)
success_rate.frontend: ~62% — 5/8 critical UI flows pass (footer modal open/close/dismiss/signin, /jobs list, JobDetail via direct URL, /jobs/new gate). 3 fail/gap: JobRow click ↛ detail nav, missing ProfilePage toggle, missing inline Stripe CTA on /jobs/new.

Front-end bugs to retest after fix: (a) JobRow click → /jobs/:id navigation; (b) ProfilePage user_kind toggle widget; (c) /jobs/new inline unlock CTA.
rca_of_the_issue: JobRow click bug RCA: JobRow is rendered as a framer-motion <motion.div> with onClick={onClick} (JobsPage.js line 211-216). Browser confirms the element receives the click (data-testid resolves and force=True click succeeds) but window.location does not change — no navigation occurs and no console error fires. The likely cause is that framer-motion's onClick prop binding can be intercepted by motion's drag/gesture handlers; the safe fix is to swap motion.div for a regular div (motion adds no critical animation here beyond entry fade) or wrap the entire row in a React Router <Link to={`/jobs/${job.id}`}>. ProfilePage user_kind toggle is simply not implemented — the page reads user.user_kind but exposes no setter UI (verified by grep on ProfilePage.js: only 'PROFESSIONAL' badge rendering present). PUT /users/me with {user_kind:'social'|'professional'} works on the backend (test_toggle_user_kind_via_put PASSES).
